title: Items, Rewards, Treasure, Handouts & Player Artifact Authoring
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Items, Rewards, Treasure, Handouts and Player Artifact Authoring over the MAS-01..12 foundations while preserving canonical Inventory/Item/Asset, ARI/D29 resource/provenance, reward/runtime and player-artifact owner authority and keeping prepared authored artifacts distinct from awarded, transferred, published or live player state.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Item, Reward, Treasure, Handout and Player Artifact authoring inside the MAS workspace without turning authored definitions into canonical inventory ownership, awarded rewards, transferred treasure, published handouts or live player-state mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically author prepared item/reward/treasure/handout/player-artifact structures over completed MAS foundations with explicit owner/resource references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/runtime authority and never treating prepared artifacts as awarded, transferred, published or live player truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-12 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

Items, Rewards, Treasure, Handouts and Player Artifacts remain prepared authoring semantics only; inventory-equipment retains canonical ownership, reward/Action/Event/runtime owners retain grant and outcome authority, ARI retains resource identity/rights, D29 authoring-provenance retains authoring/publication provenance, and player-artifact/publication owners retain delivery/publication authority.
Prepared artifacts never prove inventory mutation, reward grant/persistence, treasure transfer, handout publication/reveal, player-artifact delivery or Action/Event truth.

MAS-13 consumed explicit MAS-12 prepared references plus validated InventoryItem, Reward and PlayerArtifact owner bindings and explicit ARI/D29 resource/provenance references; unresolved references fail closed.
MAS-13 introduced no parallel inventory store, reward ledger, treasure-transfer ledger, publication system, player-artifact delivery runtime or Action/Event outcome ledger.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-13.

The first proof candidate cb6177c13f77e9a018f3533a42c91957b32f8974 failed only at mas13-invariants because governance proof punctuation did not match the verifier literal; the repair changed proof text only and production remained frozen at minimum GREEN 2882206e19ae5af54b5f0ea3fb28f554cc05f28e.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-13, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-14 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-15+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-13 is closed. MAS-14 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
